comparison.objective: Scan marked drilling sites for a hidden pipe and drill only a checked safe location.
comparison.physical_skill: Detector placement, lamp interpretation, drilling, and safety-dependent site selection.
comparison.success_condition: Drilling over the pipe or at an unchecked mark scores zero; numeric drilling and placement tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests sensing-before-action and safe site choice, not fracture at a manufactured notch or post-fracture containment.
